text: The scaling back of the parade is likely due to the threat posed by Ukrainian Uncrewed Aerial Systems (UAS) and the lack of available military equipment due to the war in Ukraine It is likely that the low key nature of the parade portrays an image of weakness with an ageing leadership uncertain of how to adequately counter the threat of Ukrainian US. There is a realistic possibility that the dismissal of Russian Aerospace Force Commander-in-Chief Viktor Afzalov a few days before the Victory Parade was due to the VKS inability to counter the UAS threat
